title: Guru Nanak’s Childhood Wonders and Balwand’s Devotion

blocks.text: This page turns from simple childhood admiration to the first public signs of Guru Nanak's spiritual mission. Guru Nanak teaches Satinam and Kartar Purakh to those around him, shaping devotion through speech, song, and the companionship of Mardana.

The narrative also gathers stories of wonder and affection that make nearby people recognize his distinct greatness before his wider journeys begin. Balwand's reverence and hospitality fit into that pattern, showing how devotion formed around the young Guru even before formal preaching expanded outward.

Read together with the adjacent readable page, the fragment belongs to a sequence of early marvels, song, and recognition. It presents Guru Nanak's childhood as already charged with the teaching and charisma that later travels will reveal more fully.
